gui.guhs.einde2_trap5_ballon.bord.begin: Click the board: the Mechanist Guh has a plan.
gui.guhs.einde2_trap5_ballon.bord.klaar: Ready for takeoff! Click the board.
gui.guhs.einde2_trap5_ballon.bord.af: The Peace Balloon floats over the Guh End.
gui.guhs.einde2_trap5_ballon.bord.zakje: There's a little bag of nibbles waiting for you!
gui.guhs.einde2_trap5_ballon.bord.morgen: Another little bag of nibbles tomorrow.
gui.guhs.einde2_trap5_ballon.wg.dicht: Not finished yet, nyeg! First my workshop and my projects. After that we'll build something really big together.
gui.guhs.einde2_trap5_ballon.wg.roep: Hey, you there! Come over to the board on the wall. I've got a plan. A plan with little ears!
gui.guhs.einde2_trap5_ballon.wg.plan1: You know what I used to do? Draw balloons. Beautiful balloons, for the Fire Nation.
gui.guhs.einde2_trap5_ballon.wg.plan2: They turned them into war balloons. Ever since, my little ears droop a bit whenever I see a balloon.
gui.guhs.einde2_trap5_ballon.wg.plan3: But now there's a factory in your world that never gets tired. So together we'll build a balloon that drops nothing but nibbles. A Peace Balloon!
gui.guhs.einde2_trap5_ballon.wg.plan4: Five stages: cloth, basket, burner, nibble supply and decorations. Your factory delivers, I sew and screw. Bring everything to this board. In portions is fine, I count it all. Nyeg!
gui.guhs.einde2_trap5_ballon.wg.fase1: The cloth! Soft, strong and a little cheese-yellow. I hung it on the crane right away.
gui.guhs.einde2_trap5_ballon.wg.fase2: A basket of real wood, with box shell in the bottom. It never breaks, not even when a chonky guh jumps in.
gui.guhs.einde2_trap5_ballon.wg.fase3: The burner is in! It runs on chonk power from your very own factory. No coal, no smoke. And look: it has a little snoot. It's happy.
gui.guhs.einde2_trap5_ballon.wg.fase4: Bags full of nibbles. I only tasted three. Or five. For quality control, nyeg.
gui.guhs.einde2_trap5_ballon.wg.fase5: Ears on, little flags up, a snoot on the cloth... EUREKA! It's done!
gui.guhs.einde2_trap5_ballon.wg.klaar: It's done. The burner purrs, the ropes are tight, the bags are full. Dare to come up into the sky with me?
gui.guhs.einde2_trap5_ballon.wg.wachten: No rush. A balloon likes to wait for a lovely moment.
gui.guhs.einde2_trap5_ballon.wg.af1: Did you see them? Nibbles everywhere, happy little ears everywhere. That's how a balloon should be.
gui.guhs.einde2_trap5_ballon.wg.af2: Here, a statuette for your shelf. And your own little hot air balloon, to float around calmly. You're a real Peacebringer now.
gui.guhs.einde2_trap5_ballon.wg.zakje: The Peace Balloon is back from its round. There was still a little bag of nibbles in the basket. For you!
gui.guhs.einde2_trap5_ballon.wg.morgen: You already have today's little bag. Tomorrow it'll scatter again, nyeg.
gui.guhs.einde2_trap5_ballon.wg.kwijt_ni: No worries, I had a spare. The old one has sprung a leak, it won't float anywhere anymore.
gui.guhs.einde2_trap5_ballon.wg.kwijt_no: You don't have a little balloon from me yet. The Peace Balloon first!
gui.guhs.einde2_trap5_ballon.wg.wijs_beg: My workshop is finished, but I have one more plan. A big plan! Come along to the board on the building site.
gui.guhs.einde2_trap5_ballon.wg.wijs_fas: How is the balloon doing? We are at stage %1$s, %2$s. Just bring it to the board on the building site, nyeg.
gui.guhs.einde2_trap5_ballon.wg.wijs_kla: It's finished! It is waiting for you at the board on the building site. Click it and up we go.
gui.guhs.einde2_trap5_ballon.wg.tip0: A tip: a Tinker Machine with a Blueprint of tent canvas sews faster than I do.
gui.guhs.einde2_trap5_ballon.wg.tip1: Box shell? Give a Hidey Guh a cheese nibble and it pushes one out. One a day, per Hidey Guh.
gui.guhs.einde2_trap5_ballon.wg.tip2: You make Light Rods from popped nibblechoir fruits and a guh crystal. Flash Crumbs drop from Ender Mikas.
gui.guhs.einde2_trap5_ballon.hint.bord: Bring everything to the board on the building site. In portions is fine.
gui.guhs.einde2_trap5_ballon.titel: New title: %s! Pick it in your Guhdex.
block.guhs.vredesballon.lore: The Peace Balloon, only small. Click it and it scatters a crumb.
block.guhs.vredesballon.klik: Pff! A tiny crumb of nibble floats out of the little basket.
gui.guhs.titels.hint.vredesbrenger: Build something with the Mechanist Guh that drops nothing but nibbles.
gui.guhs.verhalen.vredesballon.uitleg: The Mechanist Guh's big project: an enormous balloon that scatters nibbles over the Guh End. Your factory delivers, he sews and screws. Everyone builds their own balloon.

gui.guhs.verhalen.vredesballon.nu.2: Bring 256 logs and 16 box shells to the board on the building site.
gui.guhs.verhalen.vredesballon.waar.2: Southern Air Temple: the building site behind the workshop
gui.guhs.verhalen.vredesballon.nu.3: Bring 2 Fire Baskets, 1 Chonk Receiver, 96 grill coal and 16 crystal cheese to the board on the building site.
gui.guhs.verhalen.vredesballon.waar.3: Southern Air Temple: the building site behind the workshop

gui.guhs.verhalen.vredesballon.waar.4: Southern Air Temple: the building site behind the workshop
gui.guhs.verhalen.vredesballon.nu.5: Bring 64 light rods and 32 flash crumbs to the board on the building site.

gui.guhs.verhalen.vredesballon.nu.6: The Peace Balloon is done. Click the board and take off!
gui.guhs.verhalen.vredesballon.waar.6: Southern Air Temple: the building site behind the workshop
gui.guhs.verhalen.vredesballon.nu.klaar: The Peace Balloon is floating. Come back to the board every day for a little bag of nibbles.
gui.guhs.verhalen.vredesballon.waar.klaa: Southern Air Temple: the building site behind the workshop
gui.guhs.verhalen.vredesballon.kort.0: To the board on the building site
gui.guhs.verhalen.vredesballon.kort.6: Let the Peace Balloon take off!
scene.guhs.einde2_trap5_ballon_vredesbal: Ropes loose? Little ears inside the basket? Then off we go. Burner on!
The burner purrs on chonk power. The cloth billows, and on top two big ears slowly stand up straight.
I used to draw balloons for war. And look at that. This one flies just for the fun of it.
Above the Southern Air Temple, the hatches of the nibble bags swing open...
Twelve! No, thirteen! Momo, that one was mine!
I can't see a thing, but I can feel crumbs everywhere. Best rain ever.
A balloon without a single cannon. Uncle would put the kettle on right away.
You know what the best thing about a balloon is? There's always one more place further on to float to.
And so the Peace Balloon drifted over the Guh End. Wherever it went, it rained nibbles. Nyeg.
advancements.guhs.guheinde.einde2_trap5_: Launch the Peace Balloon over the Guh End together with the Mechanist Guh.
ftb.guhs_techniek.q.einde2_trap5_ballon_: A Plan with Little Ears

The &dMechanist Guh&r has one more big plan. On the &6building site&r behind his workshop in the Southern Air Temple hangs a board: click it. Everyone builds their own balloon, and only you see yours grow.
The Cloth
Bring 128 &dtent canvas&r (any color) and 64 &dGuh Wire&r. Tip: a Tinker Machine with a Blueprint of tent canvas.
The Basket
Bring 256 &dlogs&r and 16 &dbox shells&r. Tip: a forest in a tub, and a &dHidey Guh&r pushes you a box shell every day for a cheese nibble.
The Burner
Bring 2 &dFire Baskets&r, 1 &dChonk Receiver&r, 96 &dgrill coal&r and 16 &dcrystal cheese&r. The burner runs on &bchonk power&r from your own factory: no coal, no smoke.
The Nibble Supply
Bring 512 &dcheese nibbles&r and 128 &dfried cheese nibbles&r. Tip: the frying line and a field that harvests itself.
The Decorations
Bring 64 &dlight rods&r and 32 &dflash crumbs&r. Then the Mechanist Guh puts ears on it.
Takeoff!
Click the board and let the &dPeace Balloon&r take off. You get the &dPeace Balloon Statuette&r, your own &dhot air balloon&r and the title &6Peacebringer&r.
A Balloon on the Shelf
Put the &dPeace Balloon Statuette&r where everyone can see it. Click it: a tiny crumb floats out of the little basket.
Floating Yourself
Put your own &dhot air balloon&r on the ground and step in. Hold jump: the burner roars and you rise. The wind does the rest. Lost it? Sneak and click the board on the building site.
Nibble Rain Every Day
The Peace Balloon makes a round over the Guh End every day. Drop by the board on the building site afterwards: there's still a little bag of nibbles in the basket, just for you.
Peacebringer
Pick the title &6Peacebringer&r in your Guhdex. Who'd have thought a factory could make so many happy little ears?
